Long story short, I’m now the proud owner of a digital wallet full of regret and a Dogecoin that’s worth less than my lunch. But hey, at least I’ve learned one thing: never invest in anything your dog could have recommended.

Fast forward a week, and it crashes to $30K, and I’m staring at my screen like a confused grandparent trying to set up Wi-Fi. Panicking, I sold it off and bought Dogecoin instead because “Hey, it’s gotta go up, right?”
